milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to and visually observe the gray concrete powder pillar structure. Target is the center of the pillar at spawn-relative (3, 1, 3). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has approached it, and 60° facing tolerance confirms they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate from the gray concrete powder area to the target block column (red-white bullseye pattern). Target is the center of the column at spawn-relative (6, 1, 3). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player moved toward it from the previous landmark, and 60° facing tolerance confirms visual observation.

Uses inventory_has because mining a cobblestone_wall with a pickaxe drops the cobblestone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no cobblestone_wall in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. Note: the drop is 'cobblestone_wall' (not 'cobblestone') per CommonSenseAgent's verification.
